requirements.statement: replacement_count is the number of non-overlapping redactor spans replaced.
requirements.verification: assert exact replacement_count for replacement and mmap header cases

requirements.statement: original_input_bytes is the exact source byte count represented by the returned result, with streaming pending bytes counted only when emitted or finished.
requirements.verification: assert emitted-result source byte ownership for non-streaming and streaming cases

requirements.statement: decoded_input_text_bytes is the UTF-8 byte length of the lossy-decoded text scanned before redaction.
requirements.verification: assert lossy-decoded text byte accounting for invalid UTF-8 cases

requirements.statement: redacted_output_bytes is the UTF-8 byte length of the emitted redacted output bytes.
requirements.verification: assert output byte accounting when replacement markers grow the output and when streaming emits later

requirements.statement: secret_input_bytes_replaced is the exact original source byte count covered by replacement spans.
requirements.verification: assert replaced source bytes independently from lossy bytes and output bytes

requirements.statement: lossy_input_bytes counts original input bytes represented by lossy replacement characters.
requirements.verification: assert lossy original-byte accounting for invalid UTF-8 with and without replacement

requirements.statement: lossy_replacement_count counts U+FFFD replacement characters inserted into the scanned text before redaction.
requirements.verification: assert replacement-character counts for invalid UTF-8 and split streaming boundaries

requirements.statement: decode_was_lossy, text_length_delta, and original_to_output_delta remain derived and are not stored evidence fields.
requirements.verification: assert derived values are absent from evidence_fields and computed by tests from explicit counts

requirements.statement: Streaming redaction uses mapped decoded text with spans preserving text ranges, original byte counts, and lossy state.
requirements.verification: assert split invalid UTF-8 and split replacement cases retain exact span accounting

requirements.statement: A streaming call that buffers a partial value and emits no bytes reports zero original_input_bytes and zero redacted_output_bytes for that call.
requirements.verification: assert no-emission calls report zero byte ownership and later emission counts once

requirements.statement: Merged redaction results saturating-add every evidence count while preserving output concatenation semantics.
requirements.verification: assert every explicit field saturating-adds across forced overflow emissions

requirements.statement: Cold-tier RedactionEvidence mirrors and preserves every byte-evidence field.
requirements.verification: assert From<BytesRedactionEvidence> preserves every explicit count

requirements.statement: Mmap append reports carry the new evidence schema, and header redaction accounting uses replacement_count.
requirements.verification: assert MmapAppendReport evidence fields and ScrollbackHeader redactions_applied increments from replacement_count

requirements.statement: Evidence and fixtures retain counts, booleans, labels, and requirement ids only; no raw bytes, output text, snippets, context, offsets, or hashes of secret material.
requirements.verification: assert privacy flags and retained_material fields are all false

requirements.statement: The legacy bytes_replaced field name does not survive as a compatibility alias in first-party evidence structs.
requirements.source: Proposed Schema; Migration Checklist For ft-wjjkp.3
requirements.verification: assert forbidden legacy names are listed and absent from evidence_fields

expected_relationships: replacement_count is one
original_input_bytes equals the emitted source byte count
secret_input_bytes_replaced equals the replaced source byte count

text_length_delta is derived and may be negative
legacy saturated bytes_replaced semantics are not used
replacement_count is zero
lossy_input_bytes is greater than zero
lossy_replacement_count is greater than zero

fixtures.scenario: invalid UTF-8 adjacent to a replacement
expected_relationships: decoded_input_text_bytes reflects lossy-decoded text
secret_input_bytes_replaced excludes unrelated lossy bytes
lossy_input_bytes excludes valid replaced source bytes

expected_relationships: pending decoded spans preserve original byte counts across chunk boundaries

no-emission call owns zero source and output bytes

all u64 byte counters saturating-add
